## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what this changes and why. Link the related issue without automatically
closing a reporter-confirmation issue.

## Validation

State the builds, tests, and manual checks you ran, plus any platform you could
not check. For theme changes, include screenshots and asset provenance.

## Review notes

- Upstream source commits and preserved authorship, if applicable:
- AI assistance, if applicable:
- Compatibility, migration, or release considerations:
- Reporter confirmation or reason it is still pending, if applicable:

Maintainers and automated candidates follow the same approval process. No
automatic merge; required approvals must come from independent human developers.
